## Summary

## Scope

- [ ] Architecture boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Configuration/data compatibility considered.

## Verification

List exact commands and results.

- [ ] Formatting/static checks
- [ ] Build/package

Record server implementation/builds tested, or explain why runtime testing was not applicable.
